release_note_review.surface: CLAUDE.md very long list item startup freeze
release_note_review.reason: The official 2.1.311 note fixes a freeze while reading a CLAUDE.md that holds a very long list item. Headless still reads user, project, and local instructions. The fix does not change stream-json fields, the v2 hook rules, or the tool set.

release_note_review.surface: interrupt while an MCP resource read or skill download is outstanding
release_note_review.reason: The note is an in-process interrupt. Headless passes a strict empty MCP config. Route cancellation remains process force_stop.

release_note_review.surface: standard-context request over 200K tokens compacts and continues
release_note_review.reason: The official note says a standard-context request over 200K tokens compacts and continues instead of stopping with the 1M-context credit error. The credit-error function stays structurally identical. Headless does not select a context budget or compaction operation. Init still requires permissionMode plan. An unrecognized event type stays activity. The embedded changelog string is absent from the 2.1.311 binary and present in 2.1.312.

release_note_review.surface: stream-json string escaping of DEL, C1, and Unicode format characters
release_note_review.reason: The note says parsed values are unchanged. Both routes decode stream-json with serde_json. Help lines stay byte-identical. No field is added. The embedded note string is absent from the 2.1.311 binary and present in 2.1.312.
The selected command passes --no-session-persistence and does not resume a transcript.
The note stops SubagentStop hooks from running on a timer. The measured Stop and SubagentStop stop_hook_active reentry and the cap default 8 stay. Headless does not admit Agent.

Registered from 2.1.311 on the existing e path. isAvailable requires tengu_peppy_crescent with default false, a tst predicate, no --agent-id, and not mcpAutoDiscovered. The platform docs MCP URL stays behind mayConnectMcpServer. Headless still passes strict empty MCP and does not select the skill.

release_note_review.surface: easel builtin also registers for remote_cowork
release_note_review.reason: From 2.1.311 the easel registration is if(e) or a remote_cowork predicate. These routes are not remote_cowork. The local e path is unchanged. Empty tools are not this route; headless tools stay Read, Glob, and Grep.
The flags belong to self-hosted-runner. The selected command does not pass them.

release_note_review.surface: VS Code, cloud, Remote Control, Cowork, Bash, MCP, IDE, and model-catalog notes
release_note_review.reason: Those notes sit outside the fixed Read,Glob,Grep tool set, the strict empty MCP config, the local subscription command, and the stream-json field set.

release_note_review.surface: invalid command name leaving claude -p with no output
release_note_review.reason: Headless does not pass --disable-slash-commands, so command loading is on the selected path. The note restores output when one command name is invalid. It adds no command and does not change stream-json fields.

release_note_review.surface: prompt and agent hook concurrency cap
release_note_review.reason: The note caps prompt and agent hooks at 24 at a time, plus at most 12 that waited past their timeout, and treats a timeout under 1 second as 1 second. The measured block, deny, rewrite recheck, and Stop reentry decisions stay. This is a scheduler bound, not a new hook decision.

release_note_review.surface: Write refusing to overwrite a large CLAUDE.md from a prefix
release_note_review.reason: The note is the Write tool. Headless tools stay Read, Glob, and Grep.
The note changes a subagent autoCompactWindow so it can only lower CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW. Headless does not admit Agent and does not select that window.
The wrapper adds an SDK declaration field. Headless does not import sdk-tools.d.ts. This does not flatten the route onto claude-agent.sdk.

release_note_review.surface: Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, cloud sessions, VS Code, and Claude Tag notes
release_note_review.reason: Those notes are outside the local subscription stream-json command.
